name: cl_disp15_noema_allday_k1p0

source.title: Claude's variant 2026-10-20: the plain 15-minute displacement follow, no EMA gate, 10:00 to 15:00, one trade per session pass (the control for the EMA gate)

entry.words: From 10:00 to 15:00 ET, a 15-minute candle whose body is at least 1.0 x ATR(14) of the candles before it is a displacement. Enter at its close in its direction. Stop at the candle's other extreme, target 1:1. One trade per session pass: up to three a day.

taught: [owner 2026-10-18] displacement = body >= k x ATR(14) of prior candles, follow it at the close
[owner 2026-10-18] stop = the displacement candle's extreme; target 1:1
[Claude 2026-10-20] no EMA gate, window 10:00-15:00, one per session pass
not_run: THE CAP: one per session pass (nyam, mid, pm), not one a day: up to three trades a day.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
A stop floor of 0.25 x ATR applies when the candle's extreme is nearer than that.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
